# MarocVows

> MarocVows is an independent multilingual discovery directory for wedding and event providers in Morocco. It helps people compare publicly listed provider information and contact providers directly.

## Primary site

- [Homepage](https://www.marocvows.com/): Search and compare providers by service and city.
- [About](https://www.marocvows.com/about.html): What MarocVows is and how the directory works.
- [Contact & corrections](https://www.marocvows.com/contact.html): Provider corrections, wedding-help enquiries and general support.
- [Wedding help](https://www.marocvows.com/wedding-help.html): Guidance for finding suitable providers.
- [For professionals](https://www.marocvows.com/provider-submit.html): Submit a real wedding or event service for review.

## Current coverage

MarocVows currently publishes 49 provider profiles across Khénifra, Fès, Meknès, Casablanca, Marrakech, Rabat and Tangier. The public site supports English, Arabic, French and Spanish. Provider details should always be confirmed directly before booking.

## Important interpretation notes

MarocVows is a discovery and comparison service, not the provider of the listed wedding services. It does not guarantee provider availability, pricing or service quality. Some listings are verified from official sources; others are clearly marked as unverified.
